output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE)
data(quakes)
stopifnot(nrow(quakes)==1000)
rows <- apply(quakes,1,function(x) paste0("[",paste(x,collapse=","),"]"))
json <- paste0("[",paste(rows,collapse=","),"]")
write.csv(quakes,"quakes.csv",row.names=FALSE)
```

cat('<script>const events=',json,';Plotly.newPlot("chart",[{x:events.map(e=>e[2]),y:events.map(e=>e[3]),text:events.map(e=>"Stations: "+e[4]+"; latitude: "+e[0]+"; longitude: "+e[1]),mode:"markers",type:"scatter",marker:{size:6,opacity:.65,color:events.map(e=>e[4]),colorscale:"Viridis",colorbar:{title:"Stations"}},hovertemplate:"Depth %{x} km<br>Magnitude %{y}<br>%{text}<extra></extra>"}],{xaxis:{title:"Depth (km)"},yaxis:{title:"Magnitude"},margin:{t:25},paper_bgcolor:"#f7fafb",plot_bgcolor:"#f7fafb"},{responsive:true});let current=0;const slides=[...document.querySelectorAll(".slide")];function show(n){current=Math.max(0,Math.min(slides.length-1,n));slides.forEach((s,i)=>s.hidden=i!==current);document.getElementById("position").textContent=(current+1)+" / "+slides.length;document.getElementById("prev").disabled=current===0;document.getElementById("next").disabled=current===slides.length-1;if(current===2)Plotly.Plots.resize("chart");}document.getElementById("prev").onclick=()=>show(current-1);document.getElementById("next").onclick=()=>show(current+1);document.addEventListener("keydown",e=>{if(e.key==="ArrowRight")show(current+1);if(e.key==="ArrowLeft")show(current-1);});</script>',sep='')
